outcome: The Financial MIS statement can now be taken away. A Download Excel control sits in the statement's own header - not the filter bar - so the file always matches the statement being looked at, even if someone changes a dropdown after generating. Verified live: 12,408 bytes of real workbook, opening to Srihari's own hierarchy and totals.
